start.promptExample1: 9 days in Japan in October for a couple, mid-range budget, first time in Japan. Include Kyoto, Tokyo, and one onsen town, with a calm pace and food-focused evenings.
start.promptExample2: 4-day Lisbon city break for two friends in June, budget-friendly, no car. Prioritize walkable neighborhoods, live music, local seafood, and one half-day beach trip.
start.promptExample3: 10-day Italy family trip with two kids in August, premium budget. Mix Rome, Florence, and Lake Garda with kid-friendly museums, short transfer times, and downtime each afternoon.
